reviews.x: I use these clips every day to section my hair for blowdrying and I love them. I have shoulder-length, thin hair that I let dry almost to completion, then twist into 5 little buns over my head and use the clips to keep them in place as I dry the sections one by one. I'm buying another set to have in my carry-on because I travel for work and am tired of remembering to re-pack them!

claims.text: Many reviewers with thick or curly hair say the clips hold their hair securely and stay in place.
Several reviewers report the clips are sturdy, durable, and high quality.
Some reviewers say the clips work well even on fine or thin hair, despite being marketed for thick hair.
A few reviewers report the clips broke after very few uses.
One reviewer found the clips did not work for their fine, soft hair despite the all-hair-types claim.
